exposure: Congenital anomalies of the cardiac conduction system
CHD after palliation or significant residual shunts
cohort: 2,815 pregnant women with cardiac pathology, including 64 GUCH patients (61 pregnant, 3 parturient)
finding: Multidisciplinary care for pregnant and parturient women with congenital heart disease greatly reduced the risk of mortality and disability in both mothers and their children.
